mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS menuId, menu_name AS menuName, menu_price AS menuPrice, menu_image AS menuImage, menu_category AS menuCategory, deleted, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM menu_read WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_read ( menu_id, menu_name, menu_price, menu_image, menu_category, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{menuName}, #{menuPrice}, #{menuImage}, #{menuCategory}, FALSE, NOW(6), NOW(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE menu_name = VALUES(menu_name), menu_price = VALUES(menu_price), menu_image = VALUES(menu_image), menu_category = VALUES(menu_category), deleted = FALSE, updated_at = NOW(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_read SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
